Bribe 5M to someone gives me +1 influence. But cost 5M. Influence bonus worth 5% of bank; bank size unknown. Also president status matters.

Simplest: produce goods now to sell later (round 4 with boom? boom applies to current market — sold already). Boom likely only round 3 market. Future prices lower. Produce 2 goods, sell next round ~9/8 each. Alternatively donkey: 1 alashi for 1 good, marginal. Shuttle: 3 goods free but 25% confiscation of grey goods — but I have 0 goods, shuttle gives 3+0=3 grey, risk confiscation. Expected 2.25 goods vs 2 free — produce safer.

Also consider bribe for influence to keep presidency and influence bonus. Bribing 5M to faction 1 (richest after me... actually I'm richest). Influence bonus 5% of bank — bank is sum of taxes etc. Likely worth more than 5M? Unknown. Keeping influence lead: I'm at 2 vs 1. Bonus likely decided by influence max; I already lead. So bribe unnecessary.

Action: produce.
